office_does: A State Representative writes and votes on Washington state law and the operating, capital, and transportation budgets, including school funding, taxes, housing, and criminal statutes.
race_blurb: Incumbent Democrat Kristine Reeves, chair of the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, faces Paul McDaniel (prefers Independent Party), a former appointed Federal Way councilmember. Reeves voted against the 2026 income tax on earnings over $1 million, which narrows the tax contrast.

candidates.summary: Incumbent state representative (2017-2019 and since 2023) who chairs the House Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee and founded the Veterans & Military Families Caucus.
highlights: Voted against ESSB 6346, the 2026 tax on income over $1 million [S3]
Cites passing laws on homeless students, senior food access, wildfire risk, and $100 million for local public safety [S1]

taxes.basis: Mixed: voted against the 2026 tax on income over $1 million, but cites helping pass college aid funded by large companies.

spending.basis: Runs on program delivery ($100M public safety, food access, paid family leave, childcare) rather than restraint.

safety.basis: Pairs first-responder resources and public-safety funding with community policing and mental-health officer programs.

healthcare.basis: Calls health care a right but backs the state public option to make insurers compete, rather than single-payer.

experience.basis: Multi-term incumbent and committee chair, against a challenger with no legislative experience.

social.basis: Voted for ESSB 5599 on youth access to gender-affirming and reproductive care; no further statements found.

parental-rights.basis: Voted for ESHB 1296, which amended the Initiative 2081 parental-rights list; no separate statement on the topic.

candidates.summary: Former appointed Federal Way City Councilmember, Marine Corps veteran, and technology consultant, running on lower taxes, public safety, housing supply, and protecting girls' sports.
highlights: Will oppose any state personal income tax and supports eliminating the sales tax on services [S3]
Listed as 'BEST CHOICE' by the King County Republican Party [S11]

taxes.basis: Pledges to reduce taxes, oppose a state personal income tax for anyone, and eliminate the sales tax on services.

spending.basis: Calls for eliminating wasteful spending and 'spending smarter' before asking taxpayers for more.

housing.basis: Emphasizes increasing supply, middle housing, ADUs, and streamlined permitting.

safety.basis: Explicitly pairs law-enforcement support with expanded addiction and mental-health treatment: 'not tougher... not softer... smarter.'

experience.basis: Former appointed city councilmember with no legislative record, running against a multi-term incumbent.

social.basis: Pledges to 'protect girls' sports' in his pamphlet statement; no further detail.

parental-rights.basis: Says parents deserve meaningful involvement and supports transparency about academic progress and more educational choice.
